comment: A template, not a corpus. The ten dialogue items are chosen by whoever owns the evaluation, because choosing them is an editorial act: they set what 'good' means for every recall number that follows. Copy this to dialogue-spec.json, replace every entry, and keep the file out of Git if the URLs are not public. license_id must be one of the values clipmill_eval.fetch.ALLOWED_LICENCES accepts; attribution is recorded verbatim into the signed licence attestation and is what credits the speaker.
